createWidget(options)

createWidget builds a widget from an options object and returns a handle you can mount anywhere.

Section 1: configuring the widget

The widget reads its settings from a configuration object and applies them when it mounts. The widget reads its settings from a configuration object and applies them when it mounts. The widget reads its settings from a configuration object and applies them when it mounts. The widget reads its settings from a configuration object and applies them when it mounts. 

const widget = createWidget({ size: 1, theme: "dark" });
widget.mount(document.body);
